sandbachFocus: Sandbach United's sole fixture this week sees them host Eccleshall at home on Saturday 19 September at 15:00. The Ramblers came into the match as the 3rd-placed side looking to capitalize on their five-game unbeaten run, facing 4th-placed Eccleshall who arrived on a four-game winning streak. Sandbach took the lead through Josh Fowles early in the first half and held on despite Eccleshall's strong second-half pressure, with Sandbach playing the closing stages with ten men following Hatton's sin bin—final score Sandbach United 1-0 Eccleshall.
divisionWide: The title race remains wide open at the top as AFC Bridgnorth (2nd, 19 points) didn't play this week, allowing Stafford Town (2nd, 19 points) to occupy second place after fighting back from behind against Cheadle Heath Nomads in a dramatic match that saw them reduced to ten men but ultimately draw 2-2. Meanwhile, Bilston Town put on a dominant performance against Market Drayton Town, winning 3-0 away to move closer to the top four, while Wolverhampton Casuals defeated Shawbury United 3-1 away to continue climbing the table with a win. At the bottom, Allscott Heath claimed a crucial victory over struggling Alsager Town (3-1), and Barnton earned a narrow 1-0 win at Telford Town. New Mills lost away to Dawley Town 2-1, and Brereton Social held AFC Bridgnorth to a 1-0 halftime lead at home. Crewe v Wednesfield Community and Foley Meir v Widnes Town were also played but updates were limited in the provided data.
